name: watermark-remover
description: Strip AI-generated watermarks (invisible characters, vendor signatures, C2PA / EXIF / XMP metadata, and visual overlays) from text, markdown, documents, and images. Ships an MCP server with eight tools — clean_text, clean_markdown, clean_file, clean_image, detect_text, detect_markdown, inspect_file, detect_watermark — plus five per-format skills.
author: techbuzzz
exampleQueries: Clean the invisible characters out of this text from Claude.
Strip EXIF and C2PA metadata from this JPEG before I share it.
Is this email AI-generated? Don't change it, just check.
Remove the watermark from this PNG.
